admission: The checked entry of new work: intent digest idempotency, recipe policy digest pinning, and base_revision currency are verified before a task exists.
catalog: The frozen reference data (projects, agent profiles, recipes, workflow policy) staged at startup; a change is a restart with a new catalog.
control receipt: The coding_control_receipts row that makes a control operation idempotent: one row per (operation, idempotency_key); duplicates collapse onto it.
destination: One named bridge route (e.g. work.submit); the header destination must match the payload kind before any handler runs.
intent digest: The hash of a control operation's intent fields; a repeat submission with the same digest returns the original outcome instead of acting twice.
policy digest: The pinned hash of a recipe or workflow policy snapshot; admission pins it and dispatch re-verifies it.
projection: A bounded, purpose-shaped read view of stored rows (never a whole-row dump).
revision: A task's optimistic-concurrency counter; control operations carry expected_revision and fail if it has moved.
route: A RouteKey (destination + version) registered on the bridge builder and frozen at startup.
workflow: The multi-task plan/review/implement sequence a submitted task may belong to, coordinated above the admission layer.
